svg.title: A time bound carried through a target set
svg.desc: One actual orbit passes from N to M below z to the alpha and then to M prime below z. A continuation witness from M prime is concatenated with the intervening leg. The additional time allowance B times h(alpha L) minus h(L) absorbs an error C2 h(L).

g.text: One orbit, two nested entrances, one continuation
The time identities concern this orbit, not newly sampled intermediate points.
Continuation from M′ is part of the definition of E_z.
Concatenation gives the witness t + k₂ from M. See equations (19)–(22).
The change of scale pays the local timing error.
B [h(αL) − h(L)] ≥ B (√α − 1) h(L) ≥ C₂ h(L)
L = log z, h(L) = √(L log(L + 2)), B (√α − 1) ≥ C₂
The distribution comparison tests membership in E_z; the time bound is deterministic.
